notes: Originally digitized from a photo of 'GMA SAFETY LEVY.pdf' on 2026-07-12; updated 2026-07-15 from a clean source spreadsheet the user supplied ('SAFETY CHARGE FEES_GMA.xlsx'), which confirmed all 13 original rows numerically identical and added a 14th row (Passenger) not present in the scanned photo. 'SAFETY CHARGE' table gives a per-GT (gross tonnage) rate by vessel type across three successive rate regimes: '1st Old Law', '2nd Old Law', and 'New Law'. The document does not date these regimes; 'New Law' is assumed to be the current one (it's the rightmost/most-recent-sounding column) but this should be confirmed with GMA or a dated source before being treated as certain. The existing rate_table row LI2009 ('Ghana Maritime Authority Levy', $0.12/GT, used for Bulk Carrier calls) matches the 'New Law' Bulk Carrier rate here exactly.
